item_name: Nursing/Functional/Social Reassessment Not Conducted as Required
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. Audit area 26 states a reassessment frequency (upon a change in the resident's condition or at least every six months) but does not state an assessor observation/look-back window ending on an assessment reference date. The only look-back period stated anywhere in the document is in a different audit area (30. Patient Review Instrument Invalid — Resident not on site for the look back period, 'that date or the 7 days prior', p. 18), which pertains to the PRI, not to this item.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A nursing/functional/social reassessment must be conducted due to a change in the resident's condition or at least every six months; if it is not, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the nursing/functional/social reassessment is not done due to a change in the resident's condition or at least every six months, the claim will be disallowed.

federal_coding_rules.rule: This audit area applies only to service dates prior to 03/01/2015; the findings were phased out per NYS DOH Medicaid Update, February 2013, Vol. 29, No. 3.

source.quote:

federal_coding_rules.rule: The page containing this audit area is scoped to service dates 01/01/2013 through 02/28/2015.

federal.criterion: Documentation must show that a nursing/functional/social reassessment was conducted upon a change in the resident's condition or at least every six months; absence results in disallowance of the claim.

source.quote: If the nursing/functional/social reassessment is not done due to a change in the resident's condition or at least every six months, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.notes: Stated as an OMIG Audit Criteria with an explicit disallowance consequence.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The document does not tie audit area 26 to a payment or case-mix classification. (Separate audit areas 13 and 29 address rate code and PRI level, but those are distinct items.)
